Title: KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, FLA. -  Members of the STS-114 crew look over Shuttle equipment in the Orbiter Processing Facility.  In the foreground is Mission Specialist Wendy Lawrence, who is a new addition to the crew.  Behind her are (left to right) Commander Eileen Collins and Mission Specialists Andy Thomas and Stephen Robinson.  At the rear is Glenda Laws, EVA Task Leader, with United Space Alliance at Johnson Space Center.  The STS-114 crew is at KSC to take part in crew equipment and orbiter familiarization.
